_comment: Repos whose suite is ALREADY red, independent of the installer. Verified by running the
same fleet against the released v2.2.1 on 2026-08-13 and getting an identical set.
The weekly job fails on a repo that is red and NOT listed here -- that is the signal it
exists for. A repo listed here that goes GREEN is also reported, because the entry is then
stale and hiding a real gate. That report is not theoretical: vps-module and zonemta-mail
were baselined on 2026-08-13 and removed the same day once H-4 was fixed -- both had been
red because the harness could not hear their api_register() calls, not because of anything
Each entry says what is wrong, so nobody has to re-derive it. Removing an entry is how a
fix is recorded; adding one needs a reason a reviewer can check.
P-bug entries are tracked in docs/plugin-harness-findings.md in MyAdmin core and are
awaiting the owner's go-ahead per D7 -- each needs its own branch and review.

known_red.cloudlinux-licensing: S-1 getActivate()/getChangeIp() fatal, plus an A-7 hook-scoping failure. P-bug, unreviewed.
known_red.ips-vps-addon: pre-existing PluginTest failure (a registered page file that does not ship), plus B-13/B-14.
known_red.mail-module: pre-existing PluginTest suite is red -- 39 errors, all in the package's own tests, not the contract ones.
known_red.virtuozzo-vps: pre-existing PluginTest suite is red -- 52 errors in the package's own tests.
